main_text.head: VERSUS X.

p.i: Consilium inivisti ad ignominiam domus tuae, excidisti populos multos, & peccasti in animam tuam.

main_text.p: Ἐπιτίμησις est, qua Iehouah Deus noster gravissimè perstringit Regem Babylonicum, occulta cordis illius consilia in lucem proferens. Tria autem hoc loco illi tribuit.
1. Quòd consilium inierit ad ignominiam domus suae. Istud vero hauddubiè παράδοξον[?] videbatur, quòd qua ratione honori & commodis domus seu familiae suae

page.notes: Greek ζήλῳ and παράδοξον are uncertain in the scan and marked [?]. The page number is printed in old-style figures at top left and read as 252. The catchword "suae" is set alone at lower right. Spellings such as "Colos." and "hauddubiè" are copied as printed; the latter is uncertain.
